A cada 5 segundos procura jogos da sua l: Every 5 seconds it looks for games from your list among the open processes and sets their priority to High (never Realtime, which can freeze the system). When turned off, games still open go back to their original priority. Helps when many programs run in the background; with an idle PC the difference is small. Some anti-cheats block the change; in that case the game is skipped.

A pesquisa do Menu Iniciar passa a mostr: Start menu search shows only files, apps and settings on the PC, with no web results.

Abre no navegador a página oficial de re: Opens PresentMon's official releases page in the browser, to download or check manually.
Abre o arquivo games.json no Bloco de No: Opens games.json in Notepad. Put one executable name per line, in quotes and separated by commas (e.g. "cs2.exe"). The list is re-read on every check, without restarting the app.
Abre testes de movimento (UFO), de rastr: Opens motion (UFO) and ghosting tests and measures the real refresh rate. Use it to check whether the monitor is at its maximum rate and to compare motion blur.
Abre um console que roda DISM /Online /C: Opens a console that runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth (repairs the Windows image using Windows Update) and then sfc /scannow (checks system files). Use it when Windows shows strange errors. Takes 5 to 30 minutes and does not change settings. Do not close the window midway.
Abre uma janela que mede quantas leitura: Opens a window that measures how many reports per second the mouse sends (125 to 8000 Hz), using Raw Input and a high-precision clock. Move the mouse fast in circles. Higher rates slightly reduce mouse latency.
Adiciona SOMENTE a pasta do Gueibs Optim: Adds ONLY the Gueibs Optimizer folder to Microsoft Defender exclusions (Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath). Keeps the antivirus from slowing down sensor reading and the app's actions. Defender stays on for the rest of the PC; drive roots and system folders are refused. Removing uses Remove-MpPreference. Only do it if you trust the app.
Apaga o conteúdo das categorias marcadas: Deletes the contents of the checked categories after showing the total and asking for confirmation. Files in use are skipped. Shortcuts and junctions are never followed, and the Prefetch folder is never touched. It cannot be undone, but it only removes temporary files and caches that Windows and games recreate. Clearing the shader cache may cause a few stutters in the first match of each game.
Aplica a política que desliga o Copilot: Applies the policy that turns off the Copilot built into Windows and hides its taskbar button.
Applies the policy that turns off the built-in Copilot and hides the Copilot button from the taskbar.
Aplica a política que desliga o painel d: Applies the policy that turns off the Windows 11 Widgets board, which loads news and ads in the background.
Aplica a política que impede o Recall de: Applies the policy that stops Recall from saving screenshots of your activity.
Applies the policy that stops Recall from saving periodic snapshots of your screen.
Apps que já foram instalados automaticam: Apps that were already installed automatically stay there; remove them in Debloat if you want.
Baixa a versão de console do PresentMon: Downloads the console version of PresentMon from Intel's official releases page on GitHub (GameTechDev). The file is only used if its digital signature is valid and from Intel Corporation; otherwise it is deleted. Stored in %AppData%\GueibsOptimizer\tools.

Boot um pouco mais rápido e menos uso de: Slightly faster boot and less background disk and network use.

Botão Desfazer: restaura o tipo de inici: Undo button: restores the original startup type and starts DiagTrack again.

Copia o resumo do PC (CPU, GPU com VRAM,: Copies the PC summary (CPU, GPU with VRAM, memory, motherboard, disks, Windows, monitors) to the clipboard, to paste in forums or when asking for help. Does not include the user name or serial numbers.

Cria a tarefa agendada \"GueibsOptimizer: Creates the scheduled task "GueibsOptimizer\RevisaoSemanal" (Sunday, 8 PM, with administrator privileges) that runs the app with --weekly: cleans temp files and shader cache, frees RAM and shows a notification. Turning it off deletes the task. It does not apply registry tweaks.
Cria e ativa o plano \"Gueibs Optimizer: Creates and activates the "Gueibs Optimizer Performance" plan (based on Ultimate Performance or High Performance), which keeps the CPU and buses out of power saving. On laptops, it uses more battery.
Define a política de dados de diagnóstic: Sets the diagnostic data policy to the minimum level and hides Windows feedback requests.
Sets the diagnostic data policy to the minimum level and hides feedback requests. On Windows Home/Pro the effective minimum is "Required".
Deixa a própria GPU gerenciar sua fila d: Lets the GPU manage its own work queue, reducing latency and CPU use. Requires a compatible GPU and driver (WDDM 2.7+).
Deixa o menor atraso antes de uma tecla: Sets the shortest delay before a held key starts repeating and the fastest repeat rate.
Desativa \"Experiências do Usuário Conec: Disables "Connected User Experiences and Telemetry" (DiagTrack) and the WAP push message routing service (dmwappushservice).
Desativa a inicialização automática do O: Disables OneDrive's automatic startup (without uninstalling). You can still open it from the Start menu when you want to sync.
Desativa e para os serviços \"Experiênci: Disables and stops the "Connected User Experiences and Telemetry" (DiagTrack) and "WAP Push Message Routing Service" (dmwappushservice) services.
Desativa o recurso opcional \"Recall\" d: Disables the Windows optional feature "Recall" when it is installed (some Copilot+ PCs).
Desativa o recurso opcional do Windows \: Disables the Windows optional feature "Recall" (only exists on some PCs with Windows 11 24H2+). It can be re-enabled in Optional Features.
Desativa tarefas agendadas que avaliam a: Disables scheduled tasks that assess program compatibility and send Customer Experience Improvement Program data.
Desativa tarefas agendadas que coletam d: Disables scheduled tasks that collect program compatibility and Customer Experience Improvement Program data.
Desativar atalhos de Teclas de Aderência: Disable Sticky, Filter and Toggle Keys shortcuts
Desativar não apaga nada: o item é marca: Disabling deletes nothing: the item is marked as disabled in the same place Task Manager uses (StartupApproved) or the task is disabled. Re-enabling returns exactly to the previous state, and the history also appears in the Restore tab. Fewer startup programs make boot faster and free memory.
Desativar sugestões no Iniciar e na tela: Disable suggestions in Start and on the lock screen
Desliga \"Aumentar precisão do ponteiro\: Turns off "Enhance pointer precision", Windows' mouse acceleration. With it off, the same physical movement always moves the cursor the same distance.
Turns off "Enhance pointer precision": the cursor moves the same distance for the same physical movement, which helps aiming.
Desliga a captura contínua da Xbox Game: Turns off the Xbox Game Bar's continuous capture, which records the last minutes of gameplay and uses GPU and disk.
Desliga a gravação contínua em segundo p: Turns off the Xbox Game Bar's continuous background recording ("Record what happened"), which keeps recording the last minutes of gameplay.
Desliga as dicas e propagandas que apare: Turns off the tips and ads shown on the lock screen (Windows Spotlight) and the app recommendations in the Start menu.
Desliga dicas e propagandas da tela de b: Turns off lock screen tips and ads (Windows Spotlight with ads) and app recommendations in the Start menu.
Desliga dicas e sugestões do Windows, ap: Turns off Windows tips and suggestions, promoted apps in Start, silent installation of sponsored apps, ads in File Explorer and the advertising ID.
Desliga dicas, apps sugeridos no Iniciar: Turns off tips, suggested apps in Start, silent installation of promoted apps, ads in Explorer and the advertising ID.
Desliga o painel de Widgets do Windows 1: Turns off the Windows 11 Widgets board (news, weather and ads when hovering the corner of the taskbar).
Desliga os ATALHOS que abrem Teclas de A: Turns off the SHORTCUTS that open Sticky Keys (Shift 5 times), Filter Keys (hold right Shift) and Toggle Keys (hold Num Lock).
Duplica o plano \"Desempenho Máximo\" do: Duplicates Windows' "Ultimate Performance" plan (or "High Performance" if the first does not exist), names it "Gueibs Optimizer Performance" and activates it. In this plan the CPU does not lower its clock or park cores, and PCIe/USB do not enter power saving.
Enquanto ligado, o overlay recebe o mous: While on, the overlay receives the mouse so you can drag it. When turned off, the position is saved and it lets clicks pass through again.
Envia 20 pings (ICMP) para cada endereço: Sends 20 pings (ICMP) to each address and shows average, minimum, maximum, jitter (variation between consecutive pings) and loss. High jitter and loss cause teleporting and lag in online games, even with a low average ping.
Evita picos esporádicos de CPU e disco;: Avoids occasional CPU and disk spikes; the Compatibility Appraiser is known to use CPU for a few minutes.
Evita que uma janela de acessibilidade a: Prevents an accessibility window from popping up mid-match and taking focus away from the game.
Faz o botão direito do mouse mostrar dir: Makes right-click show the full menu directly, like Windows 10, without the "Show more options" step.
Garante que o Modo de Jogo do Windows es: Makes sure Windows Game Mode is on and raises the priority of the multimedia scheduler (MMCSS) "Games" task, used by games and programs that register with it.
Impede o OneDrive de abrir sozinho quand: Stops OneDrive from opening by itself when you sign in to Windows, without uninstalling it.
Impede que apertar Shift 5 vezes (ou seg: Stops pressing Shift 5 times (or holding right Shift / Num Lock) from opening accessibility windows mid-game. The features remain available in Settings.
Libera um pouco de GPU, codificador de v: Frees a bit of GPU, video encoder and disk in the background. The difference is more noticeable on weak PCs.
Liga o Agendamento de GPU Acelerado por: Turns on Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling: the graphics card itself organizes its work queue instead of Windows.
Liga o Modo de Jogo do Windows e dá prio: Turns on Windows Game Mode and gives high CPU/GPU priority to the multimedia scheduler (MMCSS) "Games" task.
Lista o que inicia com o Windows: chaves: Lists what starts with Windows: registry Run keys, Startup folders and logon scheduled tasks (except Windows' own). The "signed by" comes from the executable's digital signature.
Lê de novo as informações do PC pelo WMI: Reads the PC information again from WMI and the registry. Useful after swapping a part or updating the graphics driver.
Mais consumo de energia e calor. Em note: More power use and heat. On laptops the battery lasts much less. It does not damage the hardware.
Marca a entrada \"OneDrive\" como desati: Marks the "OneDrive" entry as disabled in StartupApproved\Run (the same as Task Manager does); nothing is deleted.
Mede download e upload por 8 segundos ca: Measures download and upload for 8 seconds each, with 4 parallel connections, using Cloudflare's public speed test servers. The upload sends only zeroed bytes. Uses data: about what your connection transfers in 16 seconds.
Mede o programa em primeiro plano com o: Measures the foreground program with Intel's PresentMon, which reads Windows events (ETW); nothing is injected. Average FPS and 1%/0.1% low are calculated over the last 10 seconds. 1% low is the average FPS of the slowest 1% of frames: it shows the stutters the average hides.
Menor atraso antes de repetir uma tecla: Shortest delay before a held key repeats and maximum repeat speed.
Menos anúncios e menos conteúdo baixado: Fewer ads and less content downloaded in the background. Does not change gaming performance.
Menos anúncios e nenhum app instalado se: Fewer ads and no apps installed without your request. Does not change gaming performance.
Menos atividade em segundo plano e menos: Less background activity and fewer diagnostics sent. The performance gain is small.
Menos dados de diagnóstico enviados e ne: Less diagnostic data sent and no rating requests. For performance, the difference is practically none.
Menos integração de IA e um botão a meno: Less AI integration and one less taskbar button. Does not change gaming performance.
Menos variação de clock e menos travadin: Less clock variation and fewer micro-stutters on CPUs that are slow to ramp up. On modern desktops the average FPS gain is usually small (0 to 3%); the main benefit is stability.
Mostra FPS, 1%/0.1% low, uso e temperatu: Shows FPS, 1%/0.1% low, CPU and GPU usage and temperature in an always-on-top transparent window that lets clicks pass through. Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+F10. It injects nothing into the game, so it is safe with anti-cheat. Works with "borderless fullscreen" or windowed mode; in exclusive fullscreen Windows does not show windows on top.
Mostra direto o menu completo do botão d: Shows the full right-click menu directly (like Windows 10), without having to click "Show more options".
Movimento previsível, que ajuda a memóri: Predictable movement, which helps muscle memory. Many games already use raw input and ignore this option, so the effect is larger in Windows and in games without raw input.
Médio: algumas ferramentas de diagnóstic: Medium: some diagnostic tools and Windows Insider stop working. dmwappushservice is used by corporate device management (MDM): do not use on a work PC.
Médio: altera um recurso do sistema e pr: Medium: changes a system feature and needs a restart to finish.
Médio: com alguns drivers e jogos causa: Medium: with some drivers and games it causes stutters, a brief black screen or issues with capture and VR. Requires restarting the PC.
Não abrir o OneDrive com o Windows: Do not open OneDrive with Windows
O LibreHardwareMonitor precisa do driver: LibreHardwareMonitor needs the PawnIO driver to read CPU temperature, clock and power. It is installed through winget (package namazso.PawnIO), digitally signed, the same one used by Fan Control and Libre Hardware Monitor. Since it is a driver, only install it if you trust the source. It can be removed in Settings > Apps.
O Modo de Jogo evita instalações de driv: Game Mode prevents driver installs and restart prompts while gaming and prioritizes the foreground process. The MMCSS effect only exists in games that use the "Games" task; in many titles the difference is small.
O Modo de Jogo já vem ligado por padrão: Game Mode is already on by default in Windows 10 and 11; here it is only confirmed.
O Programa Windows Insider exige dados d: The Windows Insider Program requires optional diagnostic data.
O painel deixa de carregar notícias em s: The board stops loading news in the background (Widgets.exe/WebView processes). Small memory and network gain.
Os arquivos só sincronizam enquanto o On: Files only sync while OneDrive is open.
Para remover o app de Widgets por comple: To remove the Widgets app completely, use the app list above (Optional category).
Pede ao Windows para esvaziar a memória: Asks Windows to empty the working set of each process (EmptyWorkingSet). Available memory is measured before and after and the value shown is the real one, which can be zero. Programs reload what they need, so the effect is temporary. Useful before opening a heavy game on PCs with little RAM; on PCs with 16 GB or more the gain is usually small. Deletes nothing and needs no undo.
Pesquisa mais rápida e só com itens do P: Faster search with only PC items; what you type in Start does not go to the internet.
Pode exigir reiniciar o Explorer ou faze: May require restarting Explorer or signing out.
Pode reduzir um pouco a latência e o uso: May slightly reduce latency and CPU use. It is required by NVIDIA Frame Generation (DLSS 3). On many systems the FPS difference is none.
Privacidade, e menos uso de disco e NPU: Privacy, and less disk and NPU use on Copilot+ PCs that have Recall.
Reinicie o Explorador (ou faça logoff) p: Restart Explorer (or sign out) to see the change.
Remove o componente por completo, além d: Removes the component completely, in addition to the policy.
Requires a restart to take effect.
Se o PC já usa Alto Desempenho ou Desemp: If the PC already uses High Performance or Ultimate Performance, the tweak already counts as applied and nothing is created.
Só aparece como aplicável no Windows 11: Only shows as applicable on Windows 11 22H2 or newer.
Only shows as applicable on Windows 11 24H2 or newer; on most PCs Recall does not even exist.
Só aparece como aplicável quando o recur: Only shows as applicable when the feature exists in your Windows.
Só aparece quando o OneDrive está config: Only appears when OneDrive is set to start with Windows.
Só calcula: soma o tamanho dos arquivos: Calculation only: adds up the file sizes of each checked category, without deleting anything.
Só conveniência: menos cliques. Não muda: Convenience only: fewer clicks. Does not change performance; that is why it is not part of the Boost or the score.
Só funciona com GPU e driver compatíveis: Only works with a compatible GPU and driver (WDDM 2.7+: NVIDIA GTX 1000+, AMD RX 5000+, Intel Arc/Xe). Without support, Windows ignores the key.
Só serviços que existem no seu Windows s: Only services that exist in your Windows are changed.
Tarefas do Agendador: Application Experi: Task Scheduler tasks: Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser, ProgramDataUpdater, PcaPatchDbTask; Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator and UsbCeip (those that exist).
Teclas seguradas repetem mais rápido no: Held keys repeat faster in Windows, editors and chats. For in-game response time the gain is practically none: games read the pressed key, not the repeat.
Takes full effect after signing out.
Tem efeito completo após sair e entrar d: Takes full effect after signing out and back in.
Takes full effect after signing out.
Tem efeito completo depois de reiniciar: Takes full effect after restarting Explorer or signing out.
Takes full effect after restarting Explorer or the PC.
Tem efeito completo depois de sair e ent: Takes full effect after signing out and back in.
Use se você já tem o PresentMon de conso: Use it if you already have the console PresentMon in another folder. The GUI app (PresentMonApplication) does not work, because it does not accept the capture arguments.
